import.title: Import from Slack
import.intro: Bring a Slack workspace's channels and their history into Messages. In Slack, an owner exports the workspace's data (Workspace settings, Import/Export Data, Export); choose the ZIP it gives you.
import.howPeople: People are matched to members of this workspace by email. Others' messages show the name they had in Slack.
import.howChannels: Public and private channels come in as new channels; a name already taken here gets a number. You're added to each one.
import.howHistory: Messages keep their original times, threads and reactions, and come in read: no one is notified.
import.downloadHint: Store the files shared in messages here. When this is off, or a file can't be reached, the message links to it on Slack.
import.working: A large export can take a few minutes. Keep this window open.
import.doneSummary: {channels, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}} and {messages, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} came in; {people, plural, =0 {no one matched a member} one {# person matched a member} other {# people matched members}}.
import.doneFiles: {count, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} downloaded.

warnings.renamed: #{from} was imported as #{to}: the name was taken.
warnings.alreadyImported: #{name} was imported before and was left as it is.
warnings.unmatchedPeople: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} matched no member by email ({names}): their messages show their Slack name. Invite them with the same email before importing to have their messages as theirs.
warnings.reactionsLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# reaction was} other {# reactions were}} left out: a custom emoji, or given by someone who matched no member.
warnings.directLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# direct conversation was} other {# direct conversations were}} left out: only channels are imported.
warnings.repliesWithoutThread: {count, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}} whose thread isn't in the export came in as messages of their own.
warnings.filesAsLinks: {count, plural, one {# file links} other {# files link}} to Slack instead of being stored here.

errors.tooManyFiles: The export has more than {limit} files.
errors.badZip: The ZIP file can't be read.
errors.badSlack: This isn't a Slack export: it has no channels.json. Choose the ZIP Slack's export gave you.
errors.busy: Another import of yours is still running. Try again when it's done.
errors.noAccess: Only owners of the workspace can import into Messages.
